1.

From pain and sorrow I flee to my stronghold, To the Father’s merciful heart.

2.

In weakness and need With Him a support I find, which never fails me.

3.

He gives me comfort At a fatherly breast And helps, when none can help.

4.

He knows what I am, Yet He loves me, My Father, forever the same.

5.

Ah, who is like Thee, So good and so rich, In heaven or on earth!
